capabilities: insert random quotes as Markdown at the cursor
insert tag-based random quotes via hotkey
insert quotes using the {{qotd}} template syntax
customize quote and tag display formats
toggle tag display in the quote footer
extras: Depends on the free Quotable API, so inserting quotes requires an internet connection; no API key is needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a random quote into a note without copying it manually.

relations.evidence: It is relying on the Quotable API.

summary: Plugin that inserts random famous quotes into the editor as Markdown, fetched from the Quotable API.
